title.original: Exploring Advanced LLM Multi-Agent Systems Based on Blackboard Architecture
title.zh: 探索基于Blackboard架构的高级LLM多智能体系统
title.en: Exploring Advanced LLM Multi-Agent Systems Based on Blackboard Architecture

inclusion_reason.zh: 共享黑板、内容感知选择器和共识循环构成通用协作运行时，可承载结构未知的多类问题。
inclusion_reason.en: The shared blackboard, content-aware selector, and consensus loop form a general collaboration runtime for problems without predefined workflows.

abstract.zh: 该系统将经典黑板架构引入 LLM 多 Agent 协作，让角色共享全局状态，并依据黑板内容动态选择下一位行动者直至达成共识。
abstract.en: This system brings blackboard architecture to LLM multi-agent collaboration, sharing global state and dynamically selecting the next actor until consensus is reached.

problem.zh: 固定工作流难处理结构未知的问题，而点对点对话会使信息分散、重复传递并阻碍 Agent 依据全局进展接棒。
problem.en: Fixed workflows struggle with problems of unknown structure, while pairwise dialogue fragments information, repeats messages, and prevents agents from acting on global progress.

approach.zh: 所有角色读写同一黑板，选择器根据当前内容决定谁应行动；写入、重选和执行循环持续到共享答案收敛。
approach.en: All roles read and write one blackboard, a selector chooses the next actor from current content, and write-select-execute cycles continue until a shared answer converges.

system_design.zh: 运行时由持久黑板、异构角色 Agent、内容感知选择器、共识/终止检查器和 token 计量模块构成。
system_design.en: The runtime consists of a persistent blackboard, heterogeneous role agents, a content-aware selector, consensus/termination checks, and token accounting.

key_results.zh: 在常识、推理和数学任务上，黑板系统以较少 token 达到与强静态和动态 MAS 相当或更好的平均表现。
key_results.en: Across commonsense, reasoning, and mathematics, the blackboard system matches or exceeds strong static and dynamic MAS averages while using fewer tokens.

limitations.zh: 全量共享会扩大上下文和隐私暴露，选择器与共识判断可能被错误黑板状态带偏；当前任务规模不足以验证长期黑板膨胀。
limitations.en: Global sharing expands context and privacy exposure, while bad blackboard state can mislead selection and consensus; long-run state growth is not tested at scale.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
